rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the physical air around us or in the atmosphere.

example.english: The air here is really fresh.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hung1 hei3 hou2 cing1 san1

rows.note: Use this for a breeze or gentle wind when the context makes its mildness clear.

example.english: The air outside is pleasantly breezy, so let’s go for a walk.
example.jyutping: ceot1 min6 jau5 fung1 heoi3 haang4 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for the mood or ambience surrounding an event or place.

example.english: The air in this restaurant is really romantic at night.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳夜晚氣氛好浪漫。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 je6 maan5 hei3 fan1 hou2 long6 maan6

rows.note: Use this for an affected sense of superiority or airs, as in someone who has airs.

example.english: They have an air of superiority and never greet anyone.
example.traditional: 佢份人好有架子，見到人都唔打招呼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 gaa3 zi2 gin3 dou2 jan4 dou1 m4 daa2 ziu1 fu1
